The Purple-tailed imperial pigeon, Ducula rufigaster, is a large frugivorous columbid endemic to the lowland rainforests of New Guinea. This considerable size is typical for the genus and reflects their dietary specialization on large fruits. In contrast, the initial wet weight at hatching is relatively modest; based on comparative data from the closely related Ducula pistrinaria, newly hatched chicks weigh approximately 29.7 grams [Ww0 = approximately 29.7 grams].
